notes: Rerank only: Jina publishes no chat completions API, so chat must never be routed here and the entry exists for /v1/rerank. base_url repeats the rerank endpoint because every provider entry carries one; it is not a chat surface, and a chat request aimed at it is rejected by Jina. Model ids are a closed enum (jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual, jina-reranker-v1-turbo-en, ...), so register the ones you use with POST /api/models/custom.
